title: SHL, SHR, ROL and ROR at the first and last bit and at a rotation of the whole width
note: IEC 61131-3 shifts and rotations work in the width of their operand: SHL(1, 31) = 16#80000000, SHR(16#80000000, 31) = 1, ROL(16#81, 1) = 16#03 (the top bit comes round), ROR(16#0001, 1) = 16#8000, SHL(16#FF, 4) = 16#F0 in a BYTE, and a rotation by the width, or by 0, leaves the value
